A block diagram showing the types of business combinations using a footwear industry supply chain. Top to bottom: Cattle Ranch -> Leather Tannery -> Shoe Factory -> Shoe Retail Shop. Vertical arrows point up for 'Backward Vertical Integration' (from Shoe Factory to Leather Tannery) and down for 'Forward Vertical Integration' (from Shoe Factory to Shoe Retail Shop). Next to the 'Shoe Factory' block is another block named 'Rival Shoe Factory' with a horizontal arrow connecting them labelled 'Horizontal Integration'. Far off to the side is a block named 'Soft Drink Factory' with a dashed arrow connecting to the 'Shoe Factory' labelled 'Conglomerate Integration'. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
